desc: Create a binary array P of size 2*10^6+1 where P[i]=1 if i is in S, else 0.
Use FFT to compute the convolution of P with itself to get an array Q where Q[k] is the number of pairs (A,C) in S such that A+C=k.
For each B in S, compute the number of fine triplets with middle element B as (Q[2*B] - 1) // 2.
Sum these counts for all B in S and print the result.
